title: The Worship of All Creation
english: If all created nature worships Christ (Hebrews 1:6)—for through the recognition of the angels, it signifies a nature superior in reason, just as it was once said in the [Psalm] regarding the angels: 'Sit at my right hand' (Psalm 110:1); and he is above this—and the word of the scriptures said to worship by means of the creature, without looking back, saying, into the...
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: The Creator vs the Created
english: heaven, and seeing the sun and the moon and the stars and all the world of heaven, having been led astray, you will worship them. But as he is forbidden to worship these, so also to the other creatures, even if one should happen to be highly exalted. As also has been said before, it is proper to confirm that it is not the creature but the Creator who is [to be worshipped].
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Christ's Union with the Created Flesh
english: Christ, even if through us he united to himself the created flesh, having been granted a soul both rational and spiritual, and thus being worshiped as God by all of creation.
Time for all things, and an opportune time for every single thing under the heaven (Ecclesiastes 3:1).
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
